classification: Exploratory deterministic diagnosis; not prospective, confirmatory or a new market-information trial
objective: BTC units versus Fixed DCA under 48 identical monthly contributions fully deployed at the final close

policy_control_notes.six_month_deadline: FIFO principal age >= 6 months must deploy; opportunity purchase unchanged; final sweep unchanged
policy_control_notes.blind_six_month_delay: Every contribution waits six months, with identical final sweep
policy_control_notes.fixed80_incumbent20: Analytical capital-allocation identity; cannot manufacture timing alpha
policy_control_notes.causal_rank_24: Expanding rank including current score, max-tie convention; use incumbent until 24 scores observed

reporting: Retain all arms and 96 start windows; median, p10/p90 and calendar-era breakdown. No IID confidence intervals, selection of winner or policy promotion. Additional policy/component simulations count as exposed-history exploration.
